{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nebula''' was an organization based in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. They believed that the discovery of the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endelaan]] would result in the destruction of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and would go to any lengths to keep the planet hidden.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
